# Rankbox

> Rankbox is the AI search growth engine for founders — it researches your buyers' questions, writes daily source-backed articles, publishes to your site, and builds backlinks, engineered to get your brand cited by AI search engines like ChatGPT and Perplexity and ranked on Google.

## Pages

- [Home](/): What Rankbox does, how it works, proof, sample articles, pricing, and FAQ.

## Integrations

- [Integrations](/integrations): Every way to connect Rankbox: WordPress, Shopify, Webflow, Framer and Square Online for publishing, the REST API, and 49 AI tools through the MCP server.
- [MCP server](/integrations/mcp): Add https://rankbox.xyz/mcp to any MCP client to get AI search questions, SEO content briefs, and meta descriptions.
- [Rankbox for Claude](/integrations/claude), [ChatGPT](/integrations/chatgpt), [Lovable](/integrations/lovable), [Cursor](/integrations/cursor), [Claude Code](/integrations/claude-code): Setup guides for connecting the MCP server, one page per AI tool.

## Free Tools

- [Free Tools](/tools): Free SEO and AI-search tools — no signup required.
- [Get Recommended by ChatGPT](/tools/get-recommended-by-chatgpt): Free tool that generates a personalized LinkedIn + About-Me plan so AI engines find and recommend you.

## AI SEO Guides

- [AI SEO guides](/ai-seo): How ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews, Gemini, Claude and Perplexity — plus Copilot, Grok, Meta AI, DeepSeek, Le Chat and Manus — find and cite sources, compared side by side: indexes, crawlers, JavaScript rendering, referrers and the biggest lever for each.
- [ChatGPT SEO](/ai-seo/chatgpt): Technical guide to ChatGPT search — query fan-out and the August 2026 site: shift, OAI-SearchBot vs GPTBot vs ChatGPT-User, Bing and IndexNow, and tracking utm_source=chatgpt.com.
- [Google AI Overviews & AI Mode SEO](/ai-seo/google-ai-overviews): Eligibility (indexed, snippet-eligible, Search Console "Search generative AI" set to Include), query fan-out, snippet controls, and the Search Console generative AI report.
- [Gemini SEO](/ai-seo/gemini): How the Gemini app grounds answers in the Google Search index, what Google-Extended really blocks, and why the Search Console AI opt-out doesn't cover Gemini.
- [Claude SEO](/ai-seo/claude): Claude's web search runs on Brave Search; the ClaudeBot / Claude-SearchBot / Claude-User split; no JavaScript rendering; tracking claude.ai traffic.
- [Perplexity SEO](/ai-seo/perplexity): Perplexity's own 200B-URL index and passage reranking, PerplexityBot vs Perplexity-User, freshness filtering, and Comet Plus.
- [Microsoft Copilot SEO](/ai-seo/copilot): Copilot grounds answers in Bing's index; Bingbot, the noarchive and nocache tags, IndexNow, Bing Webmaster Tools' AI Performance report, and tracking Copilot traffic.
- [Grok SEO](/ai-seo/grok): How Grok searches the web and X, why xAI documents no crawler, what Grok cites, what Grokipedia does and doesn't do, and measuring Grok when referrers are stripped.
- [Meta AI SEO](/ai-seo/meta-ai): How Meta AI cites sources in WhatsApp, Facebook, Instagram and meta.ai; Meta-WebIndexer vs Meta-ExternalAgent, post search, and tracking Meta AI traffic.
- [DeepSeek SEO](/ai-seo/deepseek): How DeepSeek's Smart Search finds and cites pages: an undisclosed third-party search API, no documented crawler, and how to measure it.
- [Mistral Le Chat SEO](/ai-seo/mistral): How Le Chat (renamed Vibe in May 2026) cites pages from Brave Search results; the MistralAI-Index, MistralAI-User and MistralAI-Training bots.
- [Manus SEO](/ai-seo/manus): How the Manus agent researches in a cloud Chromium browser, the Manus-User agent and its Web Bot Auth signature, why robots.txt won't stop it, and tracking agent traffic.

## AI Search Glossary

- [AI search glossary](/glossary): SEO, GEO, AEO and LLM search terms, each defined in one sentence, then explained with sourced answers to real questions, an original framework or worked example, and related terms.
- [Generative engine optimization (GEO)](/glossary/generative-engine-optimization): What GEO is, GEO vs SEO, where the term comes from (Aggarwal et al., KDD 2024), how to measure it, and the Four-Gate Citation Model.
- [Answer engine optimization (AEO)](/glossary/answer-engine-optimization): Structuring content so answer engines use it as the answer itself.
- [LLM SEO](/glossary/llm-seo): Visibility in what large language models say, from training data and from live search.
- [Query fan-out](/glossary/query-fan-out): How AI engines split one question into many sub-searches, with the Fan-Out Coverage Map worked example.
- [Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG)](/glossary/retrieval-augmented-generation): How AI engines retrieve sources before writing an answer.
- [AI crawlers](/glossary/ai-crawlers): Training, search and user-triggered bots, and how to control each.
- [llms.txt](/glossary/llms-txt): What the proposed standard is, and whether AI engines use it.
- [AI share of voice](/glossary/ai-share-of-voice): How to measure how often AI answers cite you versus competitors.
- [Prompt tracking](/glossary/prompt-tracking): Running a fixed panel of buyer prompts to see who AI engines cite.
- [AI referral traffic](/glossary/ai-referral-traffic): Identifying visits from ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Claude and Copilot in analytics.

## Comparisons

Each comparison is checked against the other tool's own pricing page and docs, dated, and lists its sources. Rankbox facts describe what ships today.

- [All comparisons](/alternatives): Rankbox beside RankPill, Outrank, SEObot, Koala AI, Byword, Writesonic, Frase, Surfer SEO, and Jasper in one table: price, cost per article, publishing, backlinks, and AI visibility, plus which tool fits which job.
- [Rankbox vs RankPill](/alternatives/rankpill): Both write 30 articles a month for one site with 30 backlink credits and Reddit drafts; Rankbox is $49.50 a month, RankPill $99, with native CMS connectors.
- [Rankbox vs Outrank](/alternatives/outrank): Both publish an article a day with a backlink exchange; Outrank is $99 with ten integrations and more volume, Rankbox is $49.50 and adds Reddit drafts.
- [Rankbox vs SEObot](/alternatives/seobot): SEObot sells 9 articles for $49 up to 300 a month; Rankbox is 30 articles for $49.50.
- [Rankbox vs Koala AI](/alternatives/koala-ai): Koala sells words with model multipliers and puts autopilot on its $99 plan; Rankbox sells 30 articles on autopilot.
- [Rankbox vs Byword](/alternatives/byword): Byword is built for bulk and programmatic pages; Rankbox for one site, every day.
- [Rankbox vs Writesonic](/alternatives/writesonic): Writesonic tracks AI visibility and gives a team fixes; Rankbox produces the content on autopilot.
- [Rankbox vs Frase](/alternatives/frase): Frase adds an SEO/GEO editor and AI citation tracking; Rankbox adds backlinks, Reddit drafts, and more articles per dollar.
- [Rankbox vs Surfer SEO](/alternatives/surfer-seo): Surfer scores drafts a person writes and tracks AI answers; Rankbox writes and delivers the article itself.
- [Rankbox vs Jasper](/alternatives/jasper): Jasper helps a marketing team write across channels; Rankbox runs the article loop without an editor.

## Head-to-head comparisons

Two third-party tools at a time, run through the same rounds with a winner or a draw in each, dated list prices, and sources. Rankbox appears only as a disclosed third option and never in the scoring.

- [All head-to-heads](/compare): Every pairing, filterable by category: AI writers, content optimization, AI visibility tracking and SEO suites.
- [Surfer SEO vs Clearscope](/compare/surfer-seo-vs-clearscope): Surfer takes 4 of 7 rounds — scoring, AI drafts, keyword research and five-engine AI tracking; Clearscope takes team rollout, with unlimited users from $129.
- [Surfer SEO vs Frase](/compare/surfer-seo-vs-frase): The rebuilt Frase takes drafting and publishing, content refreshes and small-team price; Surfer takes keyword and topic research; three rounds are draws.
- [Jasper vs Writesonic](/compare/jasper-vs-writesonic): Jasper for governed, on-brand copy across every channel; Writesonic for SEO articles, WordPress publishing and AI search tracking on every plan.
- [Koala AI vs Byword](/compare/koala-ai-vs-byword): Koala for Amazon affiliate content and the lowest entry price; Byword for programmatic templates, team seats and credits that never expire.
- [Profound vs Peec AI](/compare/profound-vs-peec-ai): Profound for enterprise demand data, content agents and SOC 2; Peec AI for self-serve tracking from $95 and agency tiers with pooled credits.
- [Semrush vs Ahrefs](/compare/semrush-vs-ahrefs): Semrush for daily rank tracking, bundled AI prompt tracking and marketing beyond SEO; Ahrefs for backlink data, API access from $129 and a free plan.
